newsitem.title: UK: Cargo cancelled from July N.Sea Flotta programme.
newsitem.headline: Cargo cancelled from July N.Sea Flotta programme.

text.p: One crude cargo has been cancelled from the July loading programme for Britain's North Sea Flotta oilfield system, traders said on Friday.
The cancellation of the July 20-22 loader cuts the month's schedule to nine cargoes totalling 5.4 million barrels, from the original 10 cargoes with 5.8 million barrels aboard.
"There were production problems with some of the fields, it was a combination of things, nothing totally specific," said one trader.
Conoco officials have confirmed that production from the MacCulloch oilfield, which feeds the Flotta crude system and which was originally due on stream last December, had been further delayed.
The field, which lies some 250km (175 miles) north of Aberdeen in the central North Sea, has been hit by a series of weather-related and technical problems.
Production should eventually peak at 50-60,000 barrels per day at MacCulloch and maintain that level for 15-18 months.
